none: PAS NLM-CC7376: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]CONSTA[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLORI AEXE[RCI]TVS. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.39gms, die axis: 6
